development-methods-designs.alt: Top panel: a cross-sectional study tests four different groups, aged 20, 40, 60 and 80, all in the same year, 2025; it is fast but mixes up age with birth year. Bottom panel: a longitudinal study tests one group in 2025 at age 20, then again in 2045, 2065 and 2085; the group shrinks as people drop out. It shows change within the same people but is slow. Neither design alone shows cause and effect.
